name: ccwarden
description: Cost and context guard for Claude Code: per-conversation spend alerts, smarter compaction, prompt-cache protection.

billing.title: Billing on this machine
billing.description: metered: usage-billed plan or API key ($ per conversation). window: Pro/Max/Team subscription (% of the 5-hour window). ask: the mod asks once, on the next session start.

sessionAlertUsd.title: Spend alert step ($, metered)
sessionAlertUsd.description: Toast each time this conversation's estimated spend crosses another step.

sessionAlertPct.title: Spend alert step (% of 5h window, window)
sessionAlertPct.description: Toast each time this conversation uses another step of the 5-hour window.

sessionAlertRepeat.title: Repeat spend alerts
sessionAlertRepeat.description: Alert at every further step; off alerts only once per conversation.

coldMinTokens.title: Cold-cache guard threshold (tokens)
coldMinTokens.description: Ask before sending a prompt over an expired cache only when the context is at least this large.

limitHaiku.title: Context limit: Haiku (tokens)
limitHaiku.description: Snapshot-compact Haiku conversations past this size.

limitOther.title: Context limit: Sonnet, Opus, Fable (tokens)
limitOther.description: Snapshot-compact other models' conversations past this size.

compactMode.title: Compaction
compactMode.description: snapshot: the mod builds the compacted conversation, no summary tokens. summary: the engine's summary.

compactAt.title: Advisor: suggest compacting at (% of the model limit)
compactAt.description: The advisor suggests compacting once the context passes this share of the model limit.

junkGuard.title: Junk guard
junkGuard.description: observe: only log what it would block. enforce: block oversized reads and trim Bash output. off.

readMaxLines.title: Junk guard: max lines for a Read without a limit
readMaxLines.description: A Read with no limit on a longer file is redirected to Grep or a ranged Read.

bashMaxChars.title: Junk guard: max Bash output characters
bashMaxChars.description: Longer Bash output is cut to head and tail; the full text is saved to a file Claude can grep.

junkAllowlist.title: Junk guard: paths it leaves alone
junkAllowlist.description: Comma-separated globs, e.g. **/*.lock,docs/**. A Read of a matching file is never denied.

subagentGuard.title: Subagent guard
subagentGuard.description: Pin subagents to the subagent model, cap their report at ~300 words, and limit how many run at once.

subagentModel.title: Subagent model
subagentModel.description: Model alias subagents are pinned to, unless their type is allowlisted.

subagentAllowlist.title: Subagent types that keep their own model

maxParallelAgents.title: Max subagents running at once
maxParallelAgents.description: A spawn past this many running subagents is denied with the reason.

keepWarm.title: Keep-warm (metered, experimental; off until Q2 is confirmed)
keepWarm.description: Just before the active session's prompt cache expires, one tiny fork of the last request reads it to keep it warm, within keepWarmCapUsd. Turn on once /cw-probe fork shows it works (SPEC §9 Q2).

keepWarmMaxMin.title: Keep-warm: stop after (minutes since your last prompt)
keepWarmMaxMin.description: Keep-warm stops this many minutes after your last prompt.

keepWarmCapUsd.title: Keep-warm: $ cap per session
keepWarmCapUsd.description: Keep-warm stops once its pings cost this much in a session.

monthlyBudgetUsd.title: Month budget ($, metered)
monthlyBudgetUsd.description: This machine's monthly budget: toasts at 50%, 80% and 100% of it, with a projection. 0 turns month tracking off. Calibrate the estimate with /cw spent <amount>.

budgetModeAt.title: Budget mode at (% of month budget or 5h window)
budgetModeAt.description: Stricter thresholds and earlier suggestions from this share of the month budget (metered) or 5-hour window (window).

alertTiming.title: When spend alerts show
alertTiming.description: immediate: as soon as the step is crossed. turnEnd: held until the turn ends.

handoffDir.title: Handoff folder
handoffDir.description: Where /handoff writes its notes, relative to the project root (or absolute). Point it at a synced folder, or commit the notes, to continue on another machine.

handoffOnCompact.title: Quick handoff before every compaction
handoffOnCompact.description: A safety net: writes a quick (zero-token) handoff each time the conversation is compacted.

handoffMaxUsd.title: Full handoff: max estimated cost ($)
handoffMaxUsd.description: A full /handoff is one fork of the conversation; above this estimate it writes a quick one instead.

backgroundWatch.title: Background spend watcher
backgroundWatch.description: Name each kind of turn you didn't type (scheduled tasks, /loop, other sessions, channels) once per conversation, with its cost and the setting that stops it.

modelAdvisor.title: Model and effort advice
modelAdvisor.description: At a fresh start, before the first prompt (when a switch is free), suggest a cheaper model for routine work; note it in handoffs; say before a switch when the context is past the new model's limit. Never switches.
